name: Market-First Research

runtime_review.compute/market_attention.py: Full observed universe, adjusted completed-session return groups, fixed prior peers, common comparison coverage and session endpoints. Missing histories and unverified adjustment stay explicit. No exact index contribution without dated weights.
runtime_review.services/aql/pipeline.py: Existing numerical production precedes common research selection and remains broad for ranking and macro consumers, including N=0. One shared agenda replaces independent Home investigations; existing graph, claims, economic datasets and serializers preserved.
runtime_review.services/aql/events.py: One upfront Zopedia agenda, focused selected questions with access to wider originals, exact prior artifact selection and original research/source dates. Parallel workers retain shared allowance, original deadline and existing review. Current acquisition/review failures stay partial without discarding valid findings.
runtime_review.pipeline/jobs/attention_home_build.py: Existing Home producer owns complete history, prior textual findings, stable source captures, same-research ticker projections and one canonical public story contract. Shared Zopedia writes Attention then its Brief; technical identities belong to the application. Existing charts, drilldowns, narration and optional page producers retained. Public writing receives findings once; complete reviewed claims and originals remain in the existing reader. A concise task request replaces accumulated instructions.
runtime_review.services/attention_home_1d.py: Optional selected_symbols bypasses old name shortlist only when caller explicitly supplies it; default behavior remains unchanged for other callers.
runtime_review.services/attention_materialized.py: Additive numerical context roundtrip and strict as-of history cutoff. Existing stored publication fields preserved; no database migration.
runtime_review.services/home_view.py: API projects all selected published stories; removes hidden 16-story cutoff. Both client renderers already map the complete supplied list.
runtime_review.services/pipeline_store.py: Task-specific research pointer filtering occurs before loading large unrelated artifacts. Real PostgreSQL listing checks cover task, subject and omitted task; financial ownership and publication contracts unchanged.
runtime_review.services/zopedia_agent.py: Corrected the existing reviewer objective at source: artifact purpose controls selection and preservation. Removed unconditional high-recall competing-answer instructions; preserve source population, metric and comparison. Research retains useful hypotheses, complete knowledge rewrites preserve original detail. No new stage, gate, retry loop or response schema.

operational_verification.meaning: Data, identity, cancellation, accounting and consumer contracts; no prose grades from software tests.

numerical_verification.index_attribution: Unavailable: no dated benchmark membership and weights supplied to the production input. Covered-instrument group means are equal-weight, not official index returns.

qualification.provider: Full production DeepSeek V4 Pro thinking/high; explicit new owner exception up to $10. No GPU allocation.
qualification.comparison_history: Original ordered 20 prior investigations fixed; no rejected trial becomes historical knowledge.
qualification.storage: Isolated PostgreSQL and immutable retained inputs; production connections read-only.
qualification.whole_flow: Full local materialization completed six investigations, six stories,66ticker snapshots and five chart selections. Public output is not accepted.
qualification.changed_stage: Fresh comparisons improved narrative focus and removed the unsupported backlog deadline, but still transferred an overall-user estimate miss to U.S. users. A further source-scope review left that error and added figures back into Brief. These outputs are rejected. The shared reviewer objective is now corrected in source and awaits fresh qualitative verification.
exclusions: Narration, live intraday collection and independent optional page inference were not purchased for this comparison. Their existing adapters remain unchanged.
Quiet-day and semantic continuity checks are operational; a separate fresh quiet-day qualitative study has not been completed.
The current production baseline has an earlier cutoff; no matched whole-system cost savings ratio is claimed.
next_comparisons: Attention/Brief and chart explanations: accurate source population and uncertainty.
Focused research: preserve useful unresolved hypotheses.
Complete retained knowledge: preserve original information rather than applying briefing concision.

recall.observed: The common agenda selected the regulated-utility versus merchant-power split and longer-horizon energy leadership, beyond the prior publication.
recall.limit: Does not guarantee every missed company or prove a statistically established cluster regime change.

cost.final_accounting: Retained usage receipts and pinned prices; two ended requests lack receipts and retain original maximum bounds.

remaining_work: Qualify corrected shared review across the three artifact purposes.
After acceptance, package committed source, verify exact worker/API images and deploy development.
